agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has initial x=-0.31 and initial v=-0.48 toward negative track end, no pushes, zero sensor noise. Controller applies only ~0.8-0.9 N positive (far below 41.4 N limit) – sufficient to keep pole upright (theta margin ~0.72 rad) but insufficient to reverse cart momentum before track end. Cart drifts monotically negative: at step 250 x=-2.207 (margin 0.19 m), at 260 x=-2.349 (margin 0.05 m), at 264 x=-2.408 violating |x|<=2.4. Cause is initial negative velocity combined with controller prioritizing pole angle over cart position recovery and limited effectiveness due to heavy pole (0.29 kg) and light cart.
